title: feat(spec)!: form is a metadata type of its own, and the form doors read a form over both types
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-alice"} -->
_Requested by **Alice** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01NoziMoftaSPmzgKNjJGePH?thread=cmsg_01NoziMoftaSPmzgKNjJGePHFWD6iz7PPMS45VYs9bUvQp)_

Fixes #37086 — PR B of the card's fixed 3,000-line cut, stacked on #37366 (the rename only). Merge #37366 first, then retarget this onto `main`. The two land together, because ADR-0159:109 anchors `view.zod.ts#defineForm`, and only this PR declares it again.

Clause-②: yes (narrowing)
Metadata-protocol: narrowed
Skills-docs: follow-up #37105

## 维护者速读

- 用户可见：表单（form）成为独立的元数据类型，用 `defineForm` 定义，名字是"对象.键"；已有的旧写法（写在 view 里的表单）照常可用，公开表单地址不变。
- 收紧的地方：同名地址被占用时保存会被拒（409），只读包已定义为 form 的名字上不能再放无包归属的列表（400），撤回的表单在两种类型下都保持关闭。
- 出错时表现为保存被拒或公开表单返回 404，不会改写已存数据；可以整体撤回。
- 需要你决定的：无。有一个后续发现（表单分享密码字段是否标记为凭据），见正文末尾。

## What changes

`form` becomes a metadata type of its own (ADR-0159 card ②, items 1, 2 and 4 to 10, as the card rules them):

- **spec**
  - `FormSchema` derives every body key from `FormViewSchema` by reference. The name is `OBJECT.KEY`. `data`, `viewKind`, `config`, `isDefault`, `order` and `scope` are refused by name.
  - Also new: `defineForm`, the registry row (`*.form.ts|yml|json`), the stack's `forms:` and the `forms` translation family (with the `_views` fallback).
  - One projection, `projectViewForms`, reads the three old `view` shapes. The intake layer is `formIntakeLayer` / `openFormAt`.
  - New error code `FORM_ADDRESS_TAKEN`, a liveness ledger `form.json`, and a semantic migration entry `18.form-type-define-form-and-packageless-list-at-form-name`.
- **metadata-protocol**
  - The effective `form` read resolves over both types in the served-row order (D5).
  - A `form` left open on a held address is refused with 409 `FORM_ADDRESS_TAKEN`.
  - A `form` save, publish or delete removes the package's old-shape row of that name in the same transaction. This touches form content only: a list of that name is untouched.
  - A package-less list at a name that a read-only package authors as a `form` is refused with 400, on save, on publish of a pre-gate draft and on restore.
  - After an old-shape removal, one registry heal (`healOldShapeFormRowRemovals`) restores the `view` registry for each removed row.
  - An unreadable stored body closes the links it names, and is reported once per process at `error` the first time the form doors read it. There is no boot hook: a project kernel must not read `sys_metadata` `view` rows at boot.
- **rest**
  - `GET /forms/:slug` and its submit judge withdrawal across `form` and `view`, both effective and per-package (D6 rules 1 to 11). This narrows only.
  - When the protocol serves no `form` item, the doors project the old `view` shapes (`projectedFormsOf`), so a host that has not authored any `forms:` keeps its addresses.
- **lint**
  - New rules: `form-public-address-taken` (gating), `form-consumer-less` (advisory), `form-object-outside-closure` and `form-object-unknown`.
- **metadata, metadata-core, objectql, runtime, cli**
  - `forms` is loaded, typed, registered and counted for i18n coverage.

## Why

ADR-0159 card ②. The breaking surface is written out in `.changeset/37086-form-metadata-type.md`.

## Measure-first answer (D7-b)

- **Over a base that authors a `form` item:** a declared `view` list override at the form's name is refused with **403 NOT_OVERRIDABLE**.
- **Over an old-shape base:** the same override is **admitted**, and it closes the address.

Both cases are pinned in `packages/rest/src/public-form-two-type-withdrawal.test.ts` ("measure-first").

## Door pins and ablations

The pins are in `packages/rest/src/public-form-two-type-withdrawal.test.ts`. The harness is a real ObjectQL engine with SqlDriver on `:memory:`. Each pin drives both doors: `GET /forms/:slug` and its submit.

| Ablation | Removes | Pins that go red |
|---|---|---|
| A1 | view half of the layer | 3, 5v, narrowing |
| A2 | form half of the layer | none |
| A3 | projection step | 3, 5v, narrowing |
| A4 | whole-item name match (replaced by slug equality) | 4 |
| A5f | per-package `form` layer | none |
| A5v | per-package `view` layer | 5v |
| A6 | rule 7 (an unreadable body closes its links) | 6 |
| A7 | cross-type resolution (D5) | 7, 7 twin |
| A8 | A1 + A7 | 3, 5v, 7, 7 twin, narrowing |

Three reads are defence in depth, not single points:

- Pin 1 stays green under A1 and A8. D5's cross-type resolution, or the candidate itself, already holds the withdrawal.
- Pin 2 stays green under A2. The pair's override is itself the closed candidate.
- A5f stays green for the same reason as A2.

No pin was weakened to get these readings.

## Verification

- **Local, affected packages:** full vitest runs of spec, metadata, metadata-core, metadata-protocol, platform-objects, rest, lint, objectql, runtime and cli, green after the census fixes. The dogfood battery ran on this head. The new suites are `form-item.test.ts` (23), `i18n-resolver.form-item.test.ts` (5), `validate-form-items.test.ts` (11) and `public-form-two-type-withdrawal.test.ts`.
- **Local, gates:** the dispatch-gates families.
- **CI:** everything else is cited from CI on the same head.
- **Not from this diff:** `check:platform-checklist` also reports `areas/automation.json` ABSENT SYMBOL `FlowItemMoreMenu.tsx#FlowItemMoreMenu`. That finding is on `main` too (80da08640 and b8c8c8897).

**Edits needed outside this PR's surface** (named, not made):

- `skills/objectstack-platform/SKILL.md:33` should list `forms` among the stack's top-level keys (`check:skill-top-level-keys`). This is the skills-docs follow-up, #37105.
- `.claude/skills/spec-property-retirement`: the lines that name `defineForm` as the Studio helper.
- `ui/docs/adr/0056`: the same naming.
- ADR-0159:109: the anchor resolves again with this PR, so no edit is needed unless the ADR wants to cite `defineForm`'s new home (`view.zod.ts` keeps it).

**Finding for a follow-up:** `form:sharing.password` is allow-listed in `metadata-credential-fields.test.ts` (`NOT_A_CREDENTIAL`), because `FormSchema` reuses the shared `SharingConfigSchema`, and `view` carries the same unmarked field. Whether that field should be marked as a credential is one decision for both types, and it is not this card's.

- [x] 2. Every name I added uses the casing for its kind.
- [x] 3. No formatter ran; `pnpm lint` passes.
- [x] 4. One issue, one branch, one pull request (the card's cut: PR A #37366 + this PR B, stacked).
- [x] 5. A change that publishes carries a changeset, and both declaration lines are filled in here and in the changeset.
- [x] 6. `packages/spec` touched: its generated artifacts are regenerated and committed.
- [x] 7. No hand edits to `content/docs/references/`, `packages/*/CHANGELOG.md` or `content/docs/releases/`.
- [x] 8. Title, body and comments are in English.
